entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your attacks with sticks have become blindingly fast, and you can throw in a combat maneuver between your attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Stick-Fighting Counter, Stick-Fighting Style, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): When making a full attack using only clubs, a quarterstaff, dan bongs, saps, or tonfas, you can perform a combat maneuver as an extra attack using your full base attack bonus.
